thread:
maria: quick sync on percentile-rank admission prototype I sketched this morning. want to pin mapping and failure modes.

jon: read it. curious about mapping function from rank->admit. linear 1/score feels brittle.

maria: propose logistic mapping: score = tenant_p95/global_p95; prob = 1/(1+exp(beta*(score-1))) clamped to [min_prob,1]. beta controls steepness.

lee: logistic smoother. small-tenant variance still a problem.

maria: apply Bayes shrinkage for small tenants, t-digest for percentiles with decay window.

sam: where compute t-digests? edge or central?

maria: shard-level digests at ingestors + central merge; proxies cache thresholds TTL=2s.

jon: TTL 2s good. fallback if aggregator unreachable?

maria: if aggregator miss >500ms proxies enter degraded mode: conservative token-bucket and emit fallback_count.

lee: reserved customers bypass percentile admission; burst credits consumed before admit.

jon: abuse signals amplify score multiplicatively: effective_score = score*(1+w*abuse_score).

maria: emit denial audit events for 1h hot store; sample full events to long-term.

ops-bot: deploy: percentile-admit v0.1 canary in us-west-2

lee: rollout: observe 7d; dry-run 2%; 10% probabilistic; then region bumps.

maria: will draft RFC addendum with knobs: beta,min_prob,bayes_strength,ttl,fallback_rate,abuse_weight + proxy API example.

jon: add debug flag to force admit/deny per tenant.

maria: will include. tagging @lee @sam for review.

lee: :thumbsup:
